events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Transform Km Llc. Tamuning, GU. An employee was working for a nationwide chain of discount department stores. OnOctober 6, 2020, his employer ordered him to enter a fourteen-day quarantine. The employee was staying at home, sleeping and not working. On the morning of October 8, 2020, he was having difficulty breathing. His spouse called for an ambulance at 2:40 a.m. At about 2:45, the employee died in the ambulance on the way to the medical center. When the employee arrived at the hospital, he tested positive for COVID-19.…

events.title: Employee is killed when caught in forklift mast
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dae San Corporation. Mangilao, GU. At 4:00 p.m. on November 25, 2018, an employee was standing on an inoperable forklift. Another employee turned and noticed the employee standing on the forklift and motioned and yelled at him to get down. He then turned back to hiswork, and when he looked back at the forklift, he saw the employee's head caught in the forklift mast. The employee died from a skull fracture with laceration of the forehead and brain from being struck-by and caught-in the forklift mast.
